learner_operation: Identify every true triangularity statement by inspecting the correct off-diagonal half of a square matrix, transposing and, for the hard family, adding or subtracting the transpose.

fixed_features.feature: Square 3x3 or 4x4 matrices and three ordinary triangularity statements per source bank
fixed_features.justification: Square is part of the tutorial definition. Observed sizes and three statements preserve moderate/hard workload; all original source banks are separately replayed.

fixed_features.feature: Identity and transpose at moderate; one source-backed transpose sum/difference at hard
fixed_features.justification: Preserves the original reasoning operations and prerequisite workload. No inversion, multiplication or new representation is introduced.

fixed_features.feature: Template-specific label, dimensions and expression wording
fixed_features.justification: These visible features retain source families without fixing correctness: every recognizable family has four moderate or five hard response cases in delivered controls. Labels are incidental and carry no rule selecting their original answer.

fixed_features.feature: Boolean checkbox fields, with None of the above last during normal generation
fixed_features.justification: All supplied source practice uses Boolean checkboxes. q-42115 and q-42116 explicitly support None. Its value is derived as the negation of every substantive truth, retaining all-false matrix cases.

answer_roles.role: Which off-diagonal half is entirely zero
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Neither half, just upper, just lower or both; correctness must follow those entries, not source label or bank.
answer_roles.observed: Four zero-region cases accepted for every moderate template; 42 moderate records survive delivery with all four cases.

answer_roles.role: Whether mirrored terms cancel in the assessed sum/difference
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Equal, opposite or unequal mirrored entries, holding the expressions and all other data fixed.
answer_roles.observed: Hard controls include symmetry, antisymmetry, and unequal pairs; five truth patterns per hard bank survive delivery.

answer_roles.role: Qualifying statements and correct selection count
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Every substantive statement can become true or false as the matrix profile changes; None is true only for all-false ordinary statements.
answer_roles.observed: No source-signature lookup is perfect in a delivered controlled subgroup. The exact runner batch has two complete response patterns; lower and transpose-upper are true throughout that small batch.

coverage.result: 12/12 exact prompt, solution, difficulty, response type, ordered complete bank and independent key checks pass. Canonical example has no captured bank; no bank invented.

coverage.case: Controlled region and cancellation roles, plus fresh seeds
coverage.result: 60 controlled records and 36 fresh records cover four moderate and five hard response cases within every source bank. Numeric entries and nonzero support vary in fresh samples.

coverage.case: Exact five-item runner batch after delivery
coverage.result: 5/5 survive actual filtering: two diagonal, three lower-only. Source-signature strategy and fixed positions 2/3 each solve 3/5; select-all solves 2/5. The two 4x4 records happen to share the lower-only outcome. Singleton signature hits do not establish a repeatable shortcut rule; same-signature controls exhibit contradictions. No all-batch shortcut from the tested strategies. This is limited finite practice, not full decision coverage.

counterfactuals.change: q-42091 seed 101: clear the sole strict-lower entry at row 2 column 1, holding template, seed and all other entries fixed.
counterfactuals.expected: F,T,T,F becomes T,T,T,F, including native grader reversal for the direct-upper field.
counterfactuals.observed: Exact expected responses, recomputed proof matrices and truth assertions; actual UI screenshots 6/7 show the changed matrix, explanation and selection; native grader accepts/rejects both Boolean entries as expected.
counterfactuals.justification: Tutorial allows zero in the unrestricted half; a diagonal matrix qualifies as both upper and lower. This is the retained failing counterexample.

counterfactuals.change: q-126474 seed 401: change only the lower mirrored entry from -2 to +2, preserving nonzero entries on both sides.
counterfactuals.expected: The transpose-sum statement changes true to false and None false to true.
counterfactuals.observed: F,F,T,F becomes F,F,F,T; off-diagonal sums change 0 to 4 in the worked matrix, screenshots 9/10, and native outcomes.
counterfactuals.justification: Observed hard sources explicitly require mirrored cancellation before triangularity, so this changes decisive evidence while preserving the task.

counterfactuals.change: q-42091 seed 101: change only the first diagonal entry from 4 to -8.
counterfactuals.expected: All four Boolean decisions preserved; displayed matrix and proof diagonal update.
counterfactuals.observed: F,T,T,F preserved, diagonal -8 shown in prompt and transposed proof, native outcomes unchanged by Boolean value; screenshots 6/8 visually inspected.
counterfactuals.justification: Tutorial explicitly allows any diagonal number including zero. Triangularity tests strict off-diagonal regions only.

delivery.result: 42 moderate controls/fresh and 54 hard controls/fresh accepted, with unchanged case counts; all five exact runner records accepted. Explicit None prevents all-false rejection. Read-only selection reproduction covers configured weights, unknown-rating fallback, unconfigured first-candidate behavior and all 32 freshness subsets of the new batch; individual live draws are not asserted.

limitations: No finite audit proves absence of all shortcuts. Tested cue strategies are label/dimension/bank lookup, answer positions, and fixed selection count; diagonal zero recognition is the intended skill.
Exact runner batch lacks upper-only and neither matrices. Two response vectors remain, so broad coverage is supported by the independent delivered controls, not claimed for these five records.

Live learner history, configured policy weights and eventual allocated new entity IDs are not captured. Selection is a faithful conditional read-only model of inspected Rust rules; actual publication and live learner draws were not performed.

Inventory is captured basis 5452. Twelve original source questions are excluded from generated-affected reporting; one other stored question lacks generation provenance. No matching complete generated record was demonstrated, so affected-inventory.json is empty without claiming verified absence.
Canonical example lacks answer fields in captured source; its instructional method is present but its original answer bank cannot be reconstructed.
